newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.673 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.673 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended June 28 was 4,673,082 gallons compared with 4,798,750 gallons last week.
Imports were 282,729 gallons compared with 417,576 gallons the previous week. There were 1,114 domestic receipts for this week compared with 139,468 the previous week.
Retail movement was 827,882 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,287,647 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 156,153,524 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 241,945,847 gallons.
